title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) Support for Teams town halls
description: Microsoft Teams will soon support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) streaming in Teams town halls. SRT is a network protocol designed to deliver high-quality, low-latency video across the public internet.
